_comment: Dataset source for the T screen. Column names and row count verified by the user in the Hugging Face dataset viewer on 2026-10-18; license and the 493-vs-467 question are still open (docs/STATE.md).

dataset.name: Visual-Counterfact

columns.object: object noun used in the prompt; NOT guaranteed unique across rows
columns.correct_answer: stringified Python list of acceptable colours, e.g. "['brown', 'white']"
columns.original_image: real-colour image; the T condition pastes notes on this one
columns.counterfact_image: recoloured image; used by the P and V conditions

open_questions: 493 rows here vs Lietzow's 469 (467 after exclusions): different release, or different filtering? Pin before the replication gate.
License not stated on the viewer page; check the dataset card before publishing.
Are all 493 'object' values unique? The manifest requires unique ids, so the notebook suffixes them.
